sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Origin**: Established in 1945 as the Central Waterways, Irrigation and Navigation Commission (CWINC) by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.
• **Mandate**: Initiating, coordinating, and furthering schemes for control, conservation, and utilization of water resources throughout the country.
• **Administrative Status**: Attached office under the **Ministry of Jal Shakti** (Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation).
• **Key Metric**: Operates the **National Flood Forecasting Network** with over 300 stations across India.

items.definition: Provides for surveillance, inspection, operation, and maintenance of specified dams. CWC acts as the technical secretariat for the National Committee on Dam Safety.
A repository of nation-wide water resources data, functioning under CWC to provide a 'Single Source of Truth' for water data.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **Flood Forecasting**: Uses 'FFS' (Flood Forecasting Stations) to provide early warnings to state authorities.
• **Jal Shakti Abhiyan**: Technical support for water conservation and rainwater harvesting.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Challenges**: Inter-state water disputes, climate change-induced erratic rainfall, and aging dam infrastructure.
• **Solutions**: Implementation of the National Hydrology Project (NHP) and AI-based flood prediction models.

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'F-D-W' (Flood, Dam, Water).
• **Decoded Meaning**: CWC's core pillars: **F**lood Forecasting, **D**am Safety, and **W**ater Resource Management.

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: CWC is NOT a statutory body created by an Act of Parliament; it is an attached office of the Ministry. Do not confuse it with the 'Central Ground Water Board' (CGWB) which deals specifically with groundwater.
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Hydro-diplomacy' when discussing CWC's role in data sharing with neighboring countries (e.g., Brahmaputra data sharing with China).

keyTakeaways: CWC is the apex technical body for water resources in India.
It plays a pivotal role in the implementation of the Dam Safety Act, 2021.
It is the primary agency for flood forecasting and hydrological data management.
